context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Secure Deployment Pipeline with External API Calls.

checklist.name: Single-quote sh with secrets
checklist.description: Shell commands that reference credential variables use single-quoted strings (`sh 'curl ... $VAR'`) to prevent Groovy from interpolating them at pipeline parse time

checklist.name: withCredentials used
checklist.description: Secrets are injected via `withCredentials([...])` blocks — not via hardcoded strings or pipeline parameters

checklist.name: Both credential IDs referenced
checklist.description: The pipeline references both `service-registry-token` and `artifact-server-creds` by exact ID

checklist.name: All four stages present
checklist.description: Stages for build, deploy-staging, register-version, and upload-report are all present

checklist.name: cleanWs in post
checklist.description: Jenkinsfile `post { always { cleanWs() } }` or equivalent workspace cleanup is present
